findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 11 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: After putting \theta = 0 in (B), the book prints \tan(0 - p) = \tan 0. It should be \tan(0 + p) = \tan 0, which gives \tan p = 0.

Book correction: In the solution of part (ii) the line after "We know that the period of tangent is \pi" is printed jumbled (the "=" signs and fractions overlap). It should read \tan\left(\frac{x}{3} + \pi\right) = \tan\frac{x}{3} \Rightarrow \tan\frac{1}{3}(x + 3\pi) = \tan\frac{x}{3}, as in Step 5 above.
